counterfactual.change: Set sensor_noise from 0.00811 to 0.0, keeping all else identical. Removes noisy angle measurement that destabilizes low-rate controller, so pole stays upright for same 17 steps.

explanation: Controller destabilizes due to interaction of large dt=0.01987 (low control rate) with seeded sensor noise 0.0081 at initial theta=0.1 limit. Noisy theta measurement causes overcorrection, pumping mechanical energy from 1.47 to 9.63 and accelerating pole fall: theta 0.05@5 -> -0.15@10 -> -0.59@15 -> -0.81@17 with omega -5.7 rad/s and cart v 3.88. Removing noise stabilizes same scenario.
vision_note: The pole leans progressively farther from upright from step 14 to 16 while the cart drifts right, showing the controller failing to arrest the fall. At step 17 the pole tilt exceeds the limit and is marked red, indicating a pole_upright violation.
